assessments.summary: The argument establishes the simultaneous witness, the collinear M-word construction, the uniform distortion bound B(M,m), the water-filling overhead bound when B(M,m)<1, and convergence of the restricted minimax overhead to zero whenever ln(m_n)=o(n). The concluding obstruction to obtaining a positive asymptotic lower bound from only a prescribed subexponential rank-one family follows within that restricted scope.
scopeQualifications: The family is implicitly nonempty (m>=1), as required by beta_m and the maximum over orientations.
The result concerns only the displayed finite rank-one family; it does not control metrics outside that family or establish zero price for the full uncountable metric class.
“Explicit” means that the codebook has a displayed formula after selecting a probabilistically proved witness v; no effective deterministic or efficient witness-construction algorithm is established.
Repeated, dependent, or nongeneric orientations are allowed; no independence or general-position assumption is needed.
